seo.title: Fishing Vessel Conversion Design | Lasan Marine Co., Ltd.
seo.description: Conversion design for fishing vessels: change of fishing method, lengthening, deckhouse raising, re-engining — with stability, structure and approval documents.

fields.headline: Fishing vessel conversion and change of fishing method
fields.lead: Lengthening, a new deckhouse, a new engine or a new fishing method all change stability and structure. We recalculate exactly what is affected and prepare the conversion documents.

items.context: For example trawling to longline, purse seine or fishery support.
items.solution: New deck, hold and gear arrangement; stability checked for the new loading conditions.

items.context: A failed engine, or more speed and less fuel.
items.solution: Resistance and power, propeller selection and a shaft check for the new engine.

fields.heading: What you receive
fields.intro: A conversion design set for the yard and for approval.
fields.note: Lead time is agreed with the quote, depending on vessel type, scope and existing documents. You know each delivery date in advance.

steps.title: Send us the brief
steps.desc: Vessel type, target dimensions, operating area and any photos or documents you have.

steps.title: Scope and quote
steps.desc: We agree the scope, deliverables and schedule, with a clear price for each part.

steps.title: Design and calculations
steps.desc: Drawings and calculations with industry software and our own engineering tools.

steps.title: Review and handover
steps.desc: We answer the reviewer’s comments, update the documents and hand over the final set.

items.title: Can you convert a vessel without original drawings?
items.content: Yes. We survey and measure the vessel and redraw what is needed before preparing the conversion.

fields.heading: Planning a conversion?
fields.description: Send photos and a description of the change. We tell you what needs recalculating and quote clearly.
